remaining.smallest_problem: Define the actual finite uniform chain space for 1≤m₁<…<m_k<n, prove that forward differences followed by reverse complement differences conditional on earlier exposures are uniform fixed-size subsets of the remaining set. The two-stage law alone does not establish the whole iterated conditional law.

For positive k, prime p, n=|S|≥2, 1≤m₁<…<m_k<n, m₀=0,m_(k+1)=n, prove the uniform-chain simultaneous-sum probability is ≤∑_{j=0}^k ∏_{i∈{0,…,k}\{j}}(1/p+C_k sqrt(log n)/(n sqrt(m_(i+1)−m_i))) with one C_k>0 independent of p,S,m_i and target sums. Choose a largest gap; conditional probabilities, not independence, must multiply.
Bound the sum of the Corollary4.2 gap products over 1≤m₁<…<m_k<n by (k+1)(n/p+2C_k sqrt(log n)/sqrt n)^k, including the finite reciprocal-square-root sum and gap indexing.

Define the actual Section5 B1,B2,B3 events in the finite uniform permutation space; prove bounds 1/100,3/100,1/25 with the source constants, conditional local-collision and admissible-permutation counting lemmas, then extract good repair geometry with probability≥23/25.
